audit_metadata.title: Adversarial audit of git/lifecycle split authority and crash consistency
audit_metadata.target: Attack tracker-vs-branch ordering, non-fast-forward zombie fence, park/finish/abort delivery, push timeouts, remote ambiguity, resume/reconcile. Identify any state where tracker truth and durable branch truth can disagree and what next pickup does. Enumerate durable steps, kill windows, named frozen shapes, recovery owners.
architecture_foundation: ADR 0003: Crash Consistency of Factory Transitions (The Media Are the Journal)
ADR 0002: Claim Lease Protocol (Heartbeat / Stale-Claim / Fencing Tokens)

the_media_are_the_journal.axiom: Factory instances are strictly stateless with no external WAL or coordinator. Durable truth resides exclusively in two media: Git task branch (origin/clone) and Tracker (labels, claim comments, boundary markers). The recovery path IS the startup/pickup path.
precedents: Position rides the record pattern (Kafka/Flink offset-with-output)

durability_point_law.axiom: The durability point of any transition is its successful push to origin, never the local commit.
durability_point_law.implication: Local commits lost to host crash or partition are expendable; branch reconciliation treats unpushed local work as nonexistent or discarded if diverged.

zombie_fence.axiom: Git's rejection of non-fast-forward pushes serves as the distributed mutual-exclusion fence against zombie holders.
zombie_fence.enforcement: --force and --force-with-lease are forbidden across the codebase at compile-time (NoForcePushGuardSpec) and runtime (BestEffortPush.java:42).
zombie_fence.verification: ZombieFenceSpec.groovy proves that when a zombie wakes from a partition and attempts to push a round, origin rejects the push with non-fast-forward error, throwing RevocationDetectedException and halting the zombie at round boundary.

intent_effect_receipt_protocol.axiom: Every external mutation follows intent -> effect -> receipt. Durable intent is committed to the branch before invoking external effect, and a receipt commit clears the pending marker after. Recovery probes target first before re-driving.

sweep_universe_rule.axiom: State writes that admit a task to the sweeper's universe occur first; writes that remove it occur last, with truth markers between. Every kill window freezes a state discoverable by the standing reaper.

claim_epoch_as_provenance.axiom: Claim epoch stamped in commit trailers represents writer provenance, not a read-side admission filter. Reclaiming instances holding new epochs route branches strictly by content/shape without quarantining.

shapes.description: The branch ref exists but carries no STARTED commit.
shapes.recovery_action: Write the STARTED commit and advance to first stage.

shapes.description: The STARTED commit is present and no round has completed.
shapes.recovery_action: Execute the first pipeline stage.

shapes.description: A run is underway: rounds recorded, no outcome recorded.
shapes.recovery_action: Resume stage execution at the recorded position in state.json.

shapes.description: An outcome is recorded and human intervention is awaited. Pending write marker is a sub-state.
shapes.recovery_action: Confirm terminal write to tracker; then wait for operator decision.

shapes.description: Human decision appended and outcome cleared; branch is resumable.
shapes.recovery_action: Resume stage engine with human decision applied; reset attempt counter.

shapes.description: Terminal Completed outcome recorded; cleanup commit and tracker finish pending.
shapes.recovery_action: Deliver finish to tracker, execute finishCleanup, push, close branch; never re-enter engine.

shapes.description: Cleanup completed; factory files stripped from tip; found in commit history.
shapes.recovery_action: Terminal state; nothing to recover.

shapes.description: Envelope declares a version this factory does not support.
shapes.recovery_action: Bypasses recovery counter; quaranines immediately with version diagnosis.

shapes.description: Content is unreadable or self-contradictory.
shapes.recovery_action: Quarantine on first classification; record diagnosis.

shapes.description: Legal but unrecognized envelope file combination; keeps classification total.
shapes.recovery_action: Quarantine on first classification; record diagnosis.

shapes.description: Issue open with ready label; no active claim comment.
shapes.recovery_action: Available for claim and take by any factory instance.

shapes.description: Live claim comment present with active heartbeat within TTL.
shapes.recovery_action: Maintained by current holder instance via periodic heartbeat beats.

shapes.description: Awaiting-human label present; park marker comment posted.
shapes.recovery_action: Awaits human decision or manual unparking.

shapes.description: Finished label present or issue closed.
shapes.recovery_action: Terminal state; ignored by taker.

shapes.description: Task voluntarily released back to queue.
shapes.recovery_action: Available for claim.

shapes.description: Claim revoked by operator or fence.
shapes.recovery_action: Reclaimed by reaper.

shapes.description: Claim write initiated but heartbeat comment not yet committed or visible.
shapes.recovery_action: Swept and cleared by reaper if unconfirmed past TTL.

shapes.description: Claim comment exists but heartbeat timestamp exceeded TTL (stale lease).
shapes.recovery_action: Reaper deletes claim comment and returns issue to Ready.

shapes.description: Issue tracker index lags the underlying git branch boundary marker.
shapes.recovery_action: Reaper syncs tracker labels with durable boundary marker.

shapes.description: Issue state modified by an unrecognized actor or conflicting format.
shapes.recovery_action: Requires operator investigation; skipped by automation.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Claimed / Stale vs Branch Bare
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Crash between git branch ref creation and the initial STARTED commit.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.observer: ReaperTaskSweeper, then Next Claimant via TakeRouting
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: Reaper detects lease expiration (TTL elapsed on monotonic clock), deletes claim comment, resets tracker to Ready. Next claimant acquires lease, detects BranchShape.Bare, executes TakeRouting to write the STARTED commit, pushes to origin, and enters first stage.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Branch converges to Created -> InProgress; tracker converges to Claimed(new_holder). Zero work lost.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Ready vs Branch InProgress
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: InProgress (state.json has completed rounds, no outcome)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Predecessor holder crashed mid-round or was reaped; worktree salvaged to branch tip before exit.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: New claimant claims task on tracker. Clones branch tip, loads state.json. TakeLoadedBranchRoutes observes InProgress shape. Routes directly to StageEngine.resumeWithoutDecision. StageEngine reads current stage and attempt index from state.json, skipping already-passed rounds, and resumes execution.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Seamless fast-forward resume. No duplicate execution of green stages; judge costs preserved.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Parked (AwaitingHuman) vs Branch InProgress
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: InProgress (local work not yet marked parked)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Operator or external tool set AwaitingHuman label on tracker while branch was in progress, or tracker updated before branch commit.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: TakeDisposition inspects tracker task state. Evaluates TrackerTaskState.AwaitingHuman. Executes refuseParked(awaitingHuman.reason()), returning TakeResult.Skipped. Does not clone branch, does not claim, does not touch worktree.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Strictly halted awaiting human decision. No unauthorized autonomous stage execution.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Working / Ready vs Branch Parked (Orphaned Park with Pending Marker)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: Parked (outcome is Escalated/AwaitingHuman; pending-terminal marker present in branch)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Holder committed Escalated outcome with pending marker, but crashed before or during tracker park mutation.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: Claimant fetches branch, detects isOrphanedPark(branch) == true. Invokes TakeReconcile.deliverPark with git.branches().fenceParkDelivery. Probes tracker: if park unapplied, delivers park mutation and note. Then invokes confirmTerminalWrite, creating receipt commit that clears the pending marker, and pushes. Engine is NEVER entered.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Tracker converges to Parked; branch converges to clean Parked (pending marker cleared). Zero engine rounds executed.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Parked vs Branch Parked (Pending Marker Present)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Predecessor delivered park to tracker successfully, but crashed before the confirmation receipt commit cleared the pending marker in git.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: TakeReconcile probes tracker via fenceParkDelivery. Observes that tracker is ALREADY Parked with matching escalation details (probes target before re-driving). Skips redundant tracker write, immediately executes confirmTerminalWrite to commit receipt clearing marker, and pushes.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Branch pending marker cleared; receipt committed; both media converge to clean Parked.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Working / Ready vs Branch CompletedUncleaned (Pending Finish)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: CompletedUncleaned (outcome is Completed, factory envelopes still on tip)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Pipeline completed successfully and committed RecordedOutcome.Completed, but crashed before finishCleanup or tracker finish delivery.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: Claimant inspects branch.outcome() instanceof RecordedOutcome.Completed. Enters TakeReconcileFinish.finishUncleaned. Probes tracker finish status. Delivers finish to tracker. Executes mechanics.finishCleanup (stripping .gnomish-task/ files, creating Delivered commit). Pushes Delivered tip to origin. Engine is NEVER re-entered.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Tracker set to Finished; branch advanced to Delivered. No re-run of already-passed stages.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Finished vs Branch CompletedUncleaned
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: CompletedUncleaned (factory files still on branch tip)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Tracker finish write succeeded, but factory crashed before git finishCleanup and push.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: If tracker is already marked Finished, TakeDisposition normally skips. If claimed via reconcile path, TakeReconcileFinish detects tracker is already finished, skips tracker write, performs finishCleanup (git rm .gnomish-task/, commit Delivered), and pushes.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Branch converges to Delivered; tracker remains Finished. Completely clean convergence.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Finished vs Branch Delivered (Steady State)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: TakeDisposition checks trackerTask.state(). Evaluates TrackerTaskState.Finished. Returns TakeResult.Skipped("Task is already done (Finished) — nothing to take."). No git operations, no network calls.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Tracker Ready (Reopened Finished Issue) vs Branch Delivered
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.tracker_state: Ready (an operator manually reopened the closed issue or cleared Finished label)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Human operator reopened an already-delivered task.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: TakeDisposition checks: case TrackerTaskState.Ready when order.trackerTask().finished() -> refuseFinished(ref, order.tracker()). Sends tracker.declineFinished, posting comment that task was already delivered, and refuses to claim or re-run.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Prevents catastrophic re-execution and corruption of delivered tasks.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Local Worktree Ahead vs Origin Behind (Push Timeout / Ambiguity)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: Local: InProgress (round N committed); Origin: InProgress (round N-1)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Local commit succeeded, but subprocess push timed out or network partitioned before remote ref update ACK.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: Next push or reconcile operation invokes remoteTip.confirm(). Probes remote ref tip: if remote returns CARRIES, push was actually successful; if ABSENT, re-attempts fast-forward push; if UNKNOWN (timeout persists), appends diagnostic note ('origin did not answer') and records in-band degradation.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Idempotent fast-forward push converges origin to local tip once connection restores.

split_authority_disagreement_matrix.name: Origin Diverged vs Local Clone (Zombie Writer Fence)
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.branch_shape: Origin has round committed by Instance B; Local (Zombie Instance A) has divergent round
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.kill_window: Instance A suffered GC pause / network partition. Lease expired. Reaper returned task. Instance B claimed, committed, and pushed. Instance A woke up as a zombie and attempted to persist its divergent round.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.pickup_action: Instance A executes push. Git server physically rejects push with 'non-fast-forward' error. Push mechanism has no --force. Push fails. RevocationCheckingAttemptPersistence intercepts failure, invokes revocation check, detects lease lost, and throws RevocationDetectedException. Instance A immediately terminates work on task.
split_authority_disagreement_matrix.convergence_result: Origin remains uncorrupted at Instance B's tip. Zombie Instance A is stopped dead at the fence. Zero data loss.

durable_steps: Step 1: Create local task branch from configured base ref
Step 2: Commit initial envelopes (.gnomish-task/task.json, state.json) with STARTED stamp and ClaimEpoch
Step 3: Fast-forward push to origin remote
Step 4: Update tracker label to InProgress / Working with claim comment

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 1 (branch created locally, not pushed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next taker creates fresh branch and commits STARTED.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 2 (STARTED committed locally, unpushed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Unpushed local work is discarded on fresh clone; new instance claims and re-initializes.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 3 (STARTED pushed to origin, tracker not updated)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next claimant clones Created branch and immediately launches stage 1.

durable_steps: Step 1: Write state.json, attempt record, and trace to local worktree
Step 2: Create local git commit stamped with claim epoch trailer
Step 3: Fast-forward push commit to origin
Step 4: Send heartbeat PATCH to tracker claim comment with attempt progress

kill_windows.recovery_action: Reads strictly resolve at HEAD commit, never dirty worktree; partial files ignored.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 2 (committed locally, not pushed)
kill_windows.frozen_shape_branch: InProgress (local ahead, origin at prior round)
kill_windows.recovery_action: If re-claimed on same host, fast-forwards; if re-claimed on new host, resumes from origin tip (at most 1 duplicate attempt).

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 3 (pushed to origin, heartbeat beat failed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Heartbeat failure is non-fatal for round; next beat or round boundary updates tracker.

durable_steps: Step 1: Commit TaskOutcome.Escalated with pending-terminal write marker to branch
Step 2: Fast-forward push escalation commit to origin
Step 3: Deliver park mutation (label + escalation report comment) to tracker
Step 4: Commit confirmation receipt clearing pending marker and push to origin

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 1 (escalation committed locally, unpushed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next holder resumes from origin; engine re-evaluates escalation if condition persists.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 2 (escalation pushed with pending marker, tracker untouched)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next claimant invokes fenceParkDelivery, delivers park to tracker, commits confirmation receipt.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 3 (tracker parked, receipt commit not yet pushed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next pickup probes tracker, sees park already delivered, commits receipt clearing marker.

durable_steps: Step 1: Detect human decision comment on tracker issue
Step 2: Commit decision to branch: clear outcome, append decision, reset attempt counter (atomic single commit)
Step 3: Fast-forward push Answered commit to origin
Step 4: Update tracker label from AwaitingHuman to Working / InProgress

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 2 (decision committed locally, unpushed)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Re-reads decision from tracker on subsequent claim.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 3 (Answered pushed, tracker still AwaitingHuman)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Detects Answered shape, updates tracker label to Working, resumes stage engine.

durable_steps: Step 1: Commit TaskOutcome.Completed to task branch
Step 2: Fast-forward push Completed commit to origin
Step 3: Post completion comment and apply Finished label on tracker
Step 4: Execute finishCleanup (git rm -rf .gnomish-task/, commit Delivered) and push to origin
Step 5: Release claim comment on tracker

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 2 (Completed committed and pushed, tracker not finished)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Next claimant enters TakeReconcileFinish, completes tracker finish, runs finishCleanup, pushes Delivered.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 3 (Tracker finished, branch uncleaned)
kill_windows.recovery_action: TakeReconcileFinish detects tracker finished, executes finishCleanup, pushes Delivered.

kill_windows.window: Kill after Step 4 (Branch Delivered, claim comment remains on tracker)
kill_windows.recovery_action: Reaper sweeps stale claim comment; issue is already Finished; nothing further needed.

finding_1_tracker_toctou_window.vulnerability: Tracker operations (comments/labels) do not support atomic compare-and-swap or fencing tokens.
finding_1_tracker_toctou_window.mitigation: ClaimGuard.stillOurs performs an ETag-cached conditional GET immediately preceding every tracker write. If claim comment was deleted by reaper, write is aborted. The residual TOCTOU window costs at most an orphaned cosmetic comment, never branch corruption, and is self-healing.

finding_2_remote_push_timeout_ambiguity.vulnerability: Subprocess push termination with TIMEOUT leaves git remote status unknown.
finding_2_remote_push_timeout_ambiguity.mitigation: FirstPush and fenceParkDelivery invoke remoteTip.confirm(branch). If CARRIES, push succeeded. If UNKNOWN, in-band degradation note ('origin did not answer') is attached to terminal report rather than guessing or retrying destructively.

finding_3_reclaim_epoch_false_positive_e.vulnerability: Earlier implementations had read-side epoch comparison that quarantined legitimate reclaims of ended tenures.
finding_3_reclaim_epoch_false_positive_e.mitigation: Epoch is strictly writer provenance. ReclaimKillPoints proves that reclaiming instances holding higher epoch (e.g. 9000L) classify tips stamped by prior tenures by content alone and converge without quarantine.

finding_4_force_push_prevention.vulnerability: A force push would destroy the non-fast-forward zombie fence, allowing stale instances to clobber new holder commits.
finding_4_force_push_prevention.mitigation: Enforced by compile-time gate NoForcePushGuardSpec and runtime check in BestEffortPush.java. Origin git hooks also reject non-fast-forward updates.

unit_and_integration_specs: com.github.oinsio.gnomish.app.ZombieFenceSpec: Verifies non-fast-forward push rejection of zombie instance during partition recovery.
com.github.oinsio.gnomish.app.killpoint.ReclaimKillPoints: Verifies reclaim of parked and salvaged tips stamped by ended tenures.
com.github.oinsio.gnomish.app.TakeLoadedBranchRoutesSpec: Verifies routing of orphaned parks, uncleaned finish, and answered decisions.
com.github.oinsio.gnomish.domain.branch.BranchShapeSpec: Verifies exact 10-shape total classification and recovery owner mapping.
